entries.en:
Uin Nee is ostensibly practicing hiding and seeking, though they don't appear to be trying particularly hard at either at the moment.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

entries.en: You found me! Oh, wait─it wasn't my turn to hide... Or was it?
entries.fr: Ah, <split(<string(gstr1)>, ,1)><nbsp>! Je t'apprends peut-être qu'on adore jouer à cache-cache ici<nbsp>! Je me débrouille pas mal, d'ailleurs. Une fois, les autres ont mis des jours à me trouver<nbsp>! Hi hi, c'était trop rigolo<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
ワタシたち、かくれんぼってだぁ～いすき！
夢の中でも子どもたちと一緒に、よく遊んでいるのよ。
本気になると、時間を忘れちゃうくらい！

entries.en: Hiding and seeking are both just too much fun! Especially with the little dreamers. Why, it's <italic(1)>so<italic(0)> much fun that sometimes, I forget that they're meant to wake up!
entries.macro: Hiding and seeking are both just too much fun! Especially with the little dreamers. Why, it's <italic(1)>so<italic(0)> much fun that sometimes, I forget that they're meant to wake up!
entries.fr: Mais les meilleurs à ce jeu, ce sont les enfants de Rak'tika<nbsp>! Ils sont vraiment trop forts<nbsp>! Ils sont même meilleurs que nous, tu te rends compte<nbsp>!?
entries.ja:
なかでもラケティカ大森林の、夜の民の子どもたちは、
みんな隠れるのも見つけるのも、とっても上手！
暗～い森で鍛えられた、特別な勘が働くのかしら……？

entries.en: Those little ones from the Rak'tika Greatwood, though, are far too good at this! And we <italic(1)>can't<italic(0)> keep letting them win─we have a reputation to uphold. That's why we've been training day and night! Mostly day, though. Do you want to join us?
entries.macro: Those little ones from the Rak'tika Greatwood, though, are far too good at this! And we <italic(1)>can't<italic(0)> keep letting them win─we have a reputation to uphold. That's why we've been training day and night! Mostly day, though. Do you want to join us?
entries.fr: Donc on a décidé de s'entraîner pour essayer de les battre. Tu veux bien te joindre à nous<nbsp>?
entries.ja:
いつもすぐに見つかっちゃって、あんまりに悔しいから、
ワタシたち、かくれんぼの大特訓が必要だと考えたの！
アナタも、ワタシたちの特訓に付き合ってもらえないかしら？

entries.en: I'll let you have my turn as seeker, then! Do you know what to do when you've found someone? Sneak right up behind them and yell “Beaver”! ...Well, the sneaking and yelling are optional, but it's much more fun if you <italic(1)>really<italic(0)> scare the wings off of them!

Youpi!
Les autres ont déjà commencé! Il faut que tu trouves leur cachette à Pla Enni et ensuite que tu cries “Castor”!
entries.ja:
わーい！　友だちの「特訓中のピクシー」も喜ぶわ！
あの子は、暗～いプラ・エンニ茸窟に隠れているはずだから、
探し出せたら、「ビーバー！」って声をかけてみて！

entries.en: Uin Nee got a mortal to do their dirty work, did they? Hmph, you don't scare me! Not like those Viis children...
entries.fr: Tssk... J'ai même pas choisi ma planque, c'est pas du jeu<nbsp>! Pfff... J'arriverai jamais à battre les enfants de Rak'tika<nbsp>! Allez, je dois retourner à l'en<->traî<->ne<->ment...
entries.ja:

う～ん悔しい、もっとうまく隠れられるようならなくちゃ……！

entries.fr: Eh bien... Toi aussi tu es plutôt <if(gnum4,douée,doué)> à cache-cache<nbsp>! La prochaine fois, j'aimerais voir ce que tu vaux quand c'est nous qui te cherchons.
